title: XOR Gate
description:
A programming lab asks you to trace this fictional Python snippet:

```python
def gate(tokens):
    result = 0
    for token in tokens:
        if token % 2 == 0:
            result ^= token
    return result

print(gate([3, 4, 6, 7, 8]))
```

XOR (`^`) is applied only to even tokens, in order.
objective: Submit the printed integer as HC{value}.

hints.text: Filter the list to even numbers first: 4, 6, 8.
